issues.detail: The Vietnamese 'nguyền xin con được' (I pray that I may receive) changes the grammatical structure of the Greek. The Greek 'χαρις ελεος ειρηνη' are direct subjects/objects of the implied verb 'be' or a simple list of blessings; the Vietnamese adds a first-person petitionary request ('nguyện xin con được') that is not present in the Greek text.
